race.comment: SHELLY'S LEGACY (5) made the most of having a senior hoop in the saddle at Bendigo last time out when turning her form around to score by a neck in a similar field to this. He has the pole position, and an extra 2kg may not be enough to stop him from winning again. ASTARI (1) was another who failed to cope with the heavy Bairnsdale track last time out, but he still stuck on well to finish fourth. Stick with him on an each-way basis. OTTALAUS (3) was well ridden when scoring his maiden win at Cranbourne nearly 3 weeks ago. He has a tougher draw this time, but is still worth including in all combos. LADY MAESTRO (13) is in good form, and a wide gate is the only query for us, but in this sort of field, she is a top 4 chance again,
